data.subject: Public-records research for Raffles
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in MAYS, CBK, and PROV.

MAYS disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing on October 15, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/54187/000120677426000561/mays4703791-8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based only on public records and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
